name: Call of Duty: World at War - Spain at War
storyline:
* The campaign mode SPAIN AT WAR is about the fictional story of Belarmino Ballesteros, who will take the character in the game.

* We will have several major and minor characters to give more life to history, to set it best in the Spanish conflict.

* We can make decisions during the story that will vary the argument and get different endings depending on our choices.

* Find all collectibles in the form of letters and newspapers of the time, and special weapons to search for the different scenarios.

* Incorporates new maps, weapons, vehicles, sounds and more involved in the Spanish Civil War.
summary:
SPAIN AT WAR is a mod for Call of Duty: World At War, set in the war that devastated Spain in the 30s, the Spanish Civil War.

A different view of our history. Far from the polemics of good and evil, red or blue, SPAIN AT WAR aims to teach and entertain all those lovers of history and war games like Call of Duty, through a campaign mode and a multiplayer mode.
